actions.description: Opens a program, a document, a folder or a URL.
actions.name: Open app, file or website

params.help: A path like C:\Tools\app.exe, a folder, or a URL like https://example.com
params.label: What to open

actions.description: Starts a game installed on this PC through its launcher (Steam, Epic, GOG). Picking one puts its cover on the key.
actions.name: Open game

params.help: Pick from the games found on this PC, or paste a launcher link like steam://rungameid/730.
params.label: Game

actions.description: Sends a key combination. On a knob, roller or the dial: one combination per direction.
actions.name: Hotkey

params.help: Press: on keys and when a knob or the dial is pushed.
params.label: Keys

params.help: For games: hardware scan codes, held a moment, so games that read the keyboard directly see the press. A game running as administrator needs HubDeck run as administrator too.
params.label: Send as

actions.description: Play/pause, next and previous track for whatever is playing.
actions.name: Media control

actions.description: System volume or one app's volume. Faders set it, knobs and the dial turn it, a press mutes.
actions.name: Volume

params.label: Volume of
options: Every other app (not on another control)

params.help: Executable name as in Task Manager, e.g. spotify.exe, chrome.exe, Discord.exe. Windows only.
params.label: App

params.help: The volume window Windows shows for the volume keys of a keyboard.
params.label: Windows volume popup

actions.description: Jumps forward or back in a video or song with the shortcut of the player you pick. Knobs, rollers and the dial: turn to seek.
actions.name: Seek in a player

actions.description: Plays a sound file (WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG): a small soundboard. A press on a playing sound stops it, starts it over, or adds another copy; or the key stops every sound.
actions.name: Play sound

params.help: Leave empty for the default speakers; pick a device to play there, e.g. a virtual cable into a call or a stream.
params.label: Play on

actions.description: Mutes and unmutes the default microphone for every app. The key shows whether it is muted.
actions.name: Microphone mute

params.help: Push to talk: muted, on while you hold the key. Push to mute: on, muted while you hold it. While held, the key ignores its hold and double press.
params.label: Press

actions.description: Shows the cover, title and artist of what is playing (Spotify, a browser, any player). A press plays or pauses.
actions.name: Now playing

actions.description: Shows CPU load or temperature, memory, or GPU load, temperature or memory on a key or the dial, updated every second. A press opens Task Manager.
actions.name: System monitor

params.help: CPU temperature, and AMD or Intel GPUs, come from LibreHardwareMonitor: run it (Options > Run on Windows startup) and they show; without it the key shows a dash. NVIDIA GPUs work without it.
params.label: Show

actions.description: Shows a value that refreshes by itself on a key or the dial: from a web address (JSON or text), a Home Assistant sensor, a command, the weather or the next calendar event. Thresholds color it; with a maximum the dial draws a ring. A press opens a page, or refreshes.
actions.name: Live value

params.help: A web address that returns JSON or text, e.g. https://api.example.com/status; for a calendar its secret ICS address (Google: Settings > the calendar > Secret address in iCal format; Outlook: Publish calendar > ICS).
params.label: Address

params.help: Where the value is in the JSON, e.g. data.items.0.price; empty for a plain-text answer.
params.label: Value at

params.help: Sent as Authorization: Bearer; kept in the system's credential store, never in the profile.
params.label: Token

params.help: The entity whose state to show, e.g. sensor.living_room_temperature.
params.label: Entity

params.help: Its output's first line is shown. It runs only after you allow it with a press on the key (a shared profile cannot run commands on its own).
params.label: Command

params.help: Search for a city; the weather comes from Open-Meteo (free, no account).
params.label: Place

params.help: -1 = as it comes.
params.label: Decimals

params.help: The key turns orange from this value on; empty = never.
params.label: Warning at

params.help: The key turns red from this value on; empty = never.
params.label: Alert at

params.help: With a maximum the dial draws the value as a ring; 0 = no ring.
params.label: Maximum

params.help: A web page or file to open on a press; empty = a press refreshes.
params.label: Press opens

actions.description: The monitor's own brightness over DDC/CI: knobs and the dial turn it, faders set it. Most desktop monitors support it; laptop screens do not.
actions.name: Monitor brightness

actions.description: Switches OBS to a scene. The key lights up while that scene is live.
actions.name: Scene

params.help: Exactly as named in OBS.
params.label: Scene

actions.description: Starts or stops recording. The key turns red while recording.
actions.name: Record

actions.description: Starts or stops streaming. The key turns red while live.
actions.name: Stream

actions.description: Saves the replay buffer (start the replay buffer in OBS first).
actions.name: Save replay

actions.description: Mutes or unmutes an audio source, e.g. the microphone. The key shows when it is muted.
actions.name: Mute source

params.help: The audio source as named in the OBS mixer, e.g. Mic/Aux.
params.label: Audio source

params.help: Push to talk: muted, on while you hold the key. Push to mute: on, muted while you hold it. While held, the key ignores its hold and double press.
params.label: Press

actions.description: The OBS mixer volume of a source: faders set it, knobs and the dial turn it.
actions.name: Source volume

params.help: The audio source as named in the OBS mixer.
params.label: Audio source

actions.description: Shows or hides a source in a scene, e.g. a camera or an overlay.
actions.name: Show / hide source

params.help: Leave empty for the scene that is live.
params.label: In scene

actions.description: Pauses or resumes a running recording. The key turns red while paused.
actions.name: Pause recording

actions.description: Starts or stops the OBS virtual camera. The key turns red while it runs.
actions.name: Virtual camera

actions.description: Starts or stops the replay buffer (needed before Save replay). The key turns red while it runs.
actions.name: Replay buffer on / off

actions.description: Turns studio mode (preview and program side by side) on or off. The key lights up while it is on.
actions.name: Studio mode

actions.description: In studio mode: sends the preview scene to program.
actions.name: Transition

params.help: Leave empty for the transition chosen in OBS, or name one, e.g. Fade.
params.label: Transition

actions.description: Switches OBS to another scene collection. The key lights up while it is the current one.
actions.name: Scene collection

params.help: Exactly as named in OBS (Scene Collection menu).
params.label: Scene collection

actions.description: Switches OBS to another of its profiles (output and stream settings). The key lights up while it is the current one.
actions.name: OBS profile

params.help: Exactly as named in OBS (Profile menu).
params.label: OBS profile

actions.description: Turns a filter of a source or scene on or off. The key lights up while the filter is on.
actions.name: Filter on / off

params.help: The source or scene that has the filter.
params.label: Source

actions.description: Saves a PNG of a source or of the live scene.
actions.name: Screenshot

params.help: Leave empty for the scene that is live.
params.label: Source

params.help: Leave empty for the OBS recording folder.
params.label: Folder

actions.description: Switches Streamlabs Desktop to a scene. The key lights up while that scene is live.
actions.name: Scene

params.help: Exactly as named in Streamlabs.
params.label: Scene

actions.description: Starts or stops recording. The key turns red while recording.
actions.name: Record

actions.description: Goes live or ends the stream. The key turns red while live.
actions.name: Stream

actions.description: Saves the replay buffer (it has to be running).
actions.name: Save replay

actions.description: Starts or stops the replay buffer. The key turns red while it runs.
actions.name: Replay buffer on / off

actions.description: Turns studio mode on or off. The key lights up while it is on.
actions.name: Studio mode

actions.description: In studio mode: sends the preview scene to the stream.
actions.name: Transition

actions.description: Shows or hides a source in a scene, e.g. a camera or an overlay.
actions.name: Show / hide source

params.help: Leave empty for the scene that is live.
params.label: In scene

actions.description: Mutes or unmutes an audio source of the Streamlabs mixer. The key shows when it is muted.
actions.name: Mute source

params.help: As named in the Streamlabs mixer, e.g. Mic/Aux.
params.label: Audio source

actions.description: The Streamlabs mixer volume of a source: faders set it, knobs and the dial turn it.
actions.name: Source volume

params.help: As named in the Streamlabs mixer.
params.label: Audio source

actions.description: Sends a message to your Twitch chat.
actions.name: Chat message

params.help: Commands that start with / do not work here.
params.label: Message

actions.description: Removes all messages from your chat.
actions.name: Clear chat

actions.description: Turns a chat mode on or off: followers only, subscribers only, emotes only or slow mode. The key lights up while it is on (known after the first press).
actions.name: Chat mode

params.help: Followers only: how long someone must follow, in minutes (0 = any follower). Slow mode: seconds between messages (3-120).
params.label: Duration

actions.description: Turns Shield Mode on or off. The key lights up while it is on (known after the first press).
actions.name: Shield Mode

actions.description: Starts a commercial break (Twitch Partners and Affiliates, while live).
actions.name: Run an ad

actions.description: Sets the stream title, the game (category) or both.
actions.name: Stream title and game

params.help: Leave empty to keep the current title.
params.label: Title

params.help: As named on Twitch, e.g. Just Chatting. Leave empty to keep it.
params.label: Game

actions.description: Marks this moment of the live stream, to find it later in the video.
actions.name: Stream marker

actions.description: Clips the last moments of your live stream.
actions.name: Create clip

actions.description: Opens the clip made last with HubDeck, or your channel's clips page.
actions.name: Open last clip

actions.description: Adds the playing track to your Liked Songs, or takes it out. The key turns green while the track is liked.
actions.name: Like / unlike

actions.description: Takes the playing track out of the playlist it plays from (your own playlists), then skips to the next one (Premium).
actions.name: Remove from this playlist

actions.description: Adds the playing track to a playlist of yours.
actions.name: Add to playlist

params.help: The playlist's link (Share > Copy link) or id.
params.label: Playlist

actions.description: Turns a light, switch, fan, cover or media player on or off. The key lights up while it is on.
actions.name: Toggle device

params.help: The entity id, e.g. light.desk or switch.kettle.
params.label: Entity

actions.description: Runs a scene or a script.
actions.name: Scene or script

params.help: e.g. scene.movie_night or script.good_night.
params.label: Scene or script

actions.description: A light's brightness: faders set it, knobs and the dial turn it, a knob press toggles the light.
actions.name: Light brightness

params.help: e.g. light.desk.
params.label: Light

actions.description: Calls any Home Assistant service with data, e.g. climate.set_temperature.
actions.name: Call a service

params.help: JSON, e.g. {"entity_id": "climate.living_room", "temperature": 21}
params.label: Data

actions.description: Faders send their position, knobs and the dial turn the value, keys send the value below on press. For any DAW or synth.
actions.name: MIDI control change

params.help: Keys only: the value a press sends.
params.label: Value on press

actions.description: Plays a note while the key is held down.
actions.name: MIDI note

params.help: 60 = middle C.
params.label: Note

actions.description: Runs a program, a PowerShell or batch script, or a shell command, with arguments, without a console window if you like.
actions.name: Run command

params.help: A program, or a .ps1 / .bat / .cmd / .sh script.
params.label: Program or script

params.help: Separated by spaces; put "quotes" around one with spaces.
params.label: Arguments

actions.description: Makes a speaker, headset or microphone the default for every app. Turning goes through them in turn. The key lights up while its device is the default.
actions.name: Audio device

params.help: Leave empty to go to the next device on each press.
params.label: Device

actions.description: One key for a whole setup: Work, Game, Meeting, Recording... It switches the profile, makes your speakers or headset and your microphone the default, and lights the base edge in the mode's color, all at once. The key lights up while its profile shows.
actions.name: Day mode

params.help: Empty: the profile stays.
params.label: Profile

params.help: Empty: the speakers stay as they are.
params.label: Speakers / headphones

params.help: Empty: the microphone stays as it is.
params.label: Microphone

params.help: #rrggbb; empty: the edge keeps the profile's light.
params.label: Edge color

actions.description: Runs the first steps on one press and the second on the next, e.g. start and stop. The key shows which one comes next.
actions.name: Toggle

actions.description: Scrolls the window under the mouse pointer.
actions.name: Scroll

actions.description: Types a snippet of text, e.g. an email address or a signature.
actions.name: Type text

actions.description: Runs several actions one after another, with a pause before each if you want one.
actions.name: Multi-action

params.help: Each step waits its delay, then runs. Steps cannot contain another multi-action.
params.label: Steps

actions.description: Several jobs on one dial or knob: turning does the current one, a press switches to the next and shows its name.
actions.name: Modes

params.help: Each mode turns something: volume, scroll, a hotkey per direction, media.
params.label: Modes

actions.description: Shows what the dial can look like: turn it to go through the looks (volume, clock, now playing, computer load, timer...), live where it can be, each with its name at the top.
actions.name: Dial gallery

actions.description: One Claude Code session per key, in the order they started: blue while it works, orange blinking when it needs your permission, green when it is your turn. A press brings its terminal to the front. Connect Claude Code in Settings first.
actions.name: Session

actions.description: The dial (or a knob) goes through your Claude Code sessions: turn to pick one, the screen tells what it does, press to bring it to the front.
actions.name: All sessions

actions.description: Shows another page of keys, like a folder. Put a key back to the main page on that page.
actions.name: Go to page

actions.description: Changes the active profile: a chosen one, or the next / previous (profiles in name order). Turning a knob or the dial steps through them.
actions.name: Switch profile

actions.description: Shows the time, the date or both on a key or the dial.
actions.name: Clock

actions.description: A countdown on a key or the dial. A press starts, pauses and resumes it; once it ran out, a press sets it back. On a knob or the dial, turning sets the minutes while it is stopped.
actions.name: Timer

params.help: Put a Timer that resets on the hold or double press of the same key to have both.
params.label: A press

actions.description: Sets an LED effect on the knobs, the faders, the base edge or all of them until the profile changes; "The profile's own" sets them back. Works in multi-actions and toggles too, e.g. the base breathing red while OBS records.
actions.name: Lighting effect

actions.description: Brightness of the key panel and the dial screen: faders set it, knobs and the dial turn it, a key makes it brighter or darker.
actions.name: Deck brightness

actions.description: Presses a button of a virtual joystick (vJoy) while the key is held, for sims and games: bind it in the game's control settings. On a knob, roller or the dial each step taps a button. Windows only; needs vJoy.
actions.name: Joystick button

params.help: vJoy device 1-16 as set up in Configure vJoy. Install vJoy first: https://github.com/BrunnerInnovation/vJoy/releases
params.label: vJoy device

params.help: Held down as long as the key or the push of a knob or the dial.
params.label: Button

params.help: Knobs, rollers and the dial: tapped once per step; 0 = none.
params.label: Turn clockwise / up taps

actions.description: Moves an axis of a virtual joystick (vJoy): a fader sets it (throttle, mixture, flaps), knobs, rollers and the dial move it step by step (trim), a press centers it. Bind it in the sim. Windows only; needs vJoy.
actions.name: Joystick axis

params.help: vJoy device 1-16 as set up in Configure vJoy. Install vJoy first: https://github.com/BrunnerInnovation/vJoy/releases
params.label: vJoy device

params.help: Knobs, rollers and the dial: how far one step moves it.
params.label: Step per detent (%)

actions.description: Points a hat switch (POV) of a virtual joystick (vJoy) while the key is held, e.g. to look around. Windows only; needs vJoy.
actions.name: Joystick hat

params.help: vJoy device 1-16 as set up in Configure vJoy. Install vJoy first: https://github.com/BrunnerInnovation/vJoy/releases
params.label: vJoy device

params.help: Diagonals need a continuous hat (Configure vJoy > POV hat switch: Continuous).
params.label: Direction

presets.description: A tour on the deck: seven tabs of what HubDeck can do (the bottom-right key goes on), the dial as a gallery of its looks; press a key and the window says what it is and how to set it.
presets.name: Discover HubDeck

presets.description: Media, copy and paste, app volumes on the faders, scrolling on the rollers.
presets.name: Everyday desk

presets.description: Scenes, record, stream, replay and mic mute that light up with the real state; the OBS mixer on the faders.
presets.name: OBS streaming

presets.description: Mute, camera, leave and raise hand for Discord, Teams, Zoom and Google Meet.
presets.name: Discord & meetings

presets.description: Tools on the keys, brush size on the dial, zoom and history on the knobs.
presets.name: Photoshop

presets.description: Tools, group and paste in front / back on the keys, zoom on the dial, history and arranging on the knobs.
presets.name: Illustrator

presets.description: Pick, reject and stars on the keys; Develop sliders on the knobs; photos on a roller.
presets.name: Lightroom

presets.description: Jog and shuttle: the dial shuttles (J/L, faster as you turn faster), a press plays; frames and timeline zoom on the rollers; cut, mark and play on the keys.
presets.name: Premiere Pro

presets.description: Jog and shuttle for the Edit page: the dial shuttles (J/L), a press plays; frames and timeline zoom on the rollers; blade, ripple delete, marks on the keys.
presets.name: DaVinci Resolve

presets.description: Jog and shuttle: the dial shuttles (J/L), a press plays or pauses; frames and timeline zoom on the rollers; split, auto ripple, marks on the keys.
presets.name: VEGAS Pro

presets.description: CapCut for Windows: the dial jumps through the video (faster as you turn faster), a press plays; frames and timeline zoom on the rollers; split, marks on the keys.
presets.name: CapCut

presets.description: Jog and shuttle: the dial shuttles (J/L), a press plays; frames and timeline zoom on the rollers; split, ripple delete, lift, marks on the keys.
presets.name: Shotcut

presets.description: A key per Claude Code session showing whether it works, asks or waits for you; all sessions on the dial.
presets.name: Claude Code

presets.description: Number and ability keys, zoom and item cycle, game chat and music volumes.
presets.name: Game action bar

presets.description: The deck as a joystick for flight and racing sims (Windows, needs vJoy): 15 buttons, throttle, mixture, prop, flaps and trim on the faders, axes on the knobs. Bind them in your sim's control settings.
presets.name: Sim panel

presets.description: Time, weather, your next meeting, computer load, a website, a build, home sensors and a price on the keys, refreshing by themselves and turning orange or red past their limits. Set up your place, calendar and addresses on the keys that ask for it.
presets.name: Status board

presets.description: The games installed on this PC with their covers: a key starts one.
presets.name: My games

presets.description: Scene cards, going live and recording in red, markers and clips, the stream mixer on the faders.
presets.name: Stream live

presets.description: A night sky across the keys, a 25-minute focus timer on the dial, lo-fi music, a calm breathing edge.
presets.name: Night focus

presets.description: The track and its cover on the dial, like and save, an animated equalizer, Spotify green throughout.
presets.name: Spotify studio

presets.description: Tap, hold, double press, multi-action, toggle, pages, mute and push-to-talk, timer, clock, typing.
presets.name: Test: keys & gestures

presets.description: Own pictures and animated GIFs on keys and the dial, colors, edge and LED colors.
presets.name: Test: looks

presets.description: Dial modes, fast turning, app volume, deck and monitor brightness, profiles by turning.
presets.name: Test: knobs, dial, rollers

presets.description: Now playing, system monitor, OBS, Streamlabs, Spotify, audio devices, Home Assistant, Twitch.
presets.name: Test: integrations

presets.description: Apps found on this PC as keys with their real icons, animated art on the dial and keys.
presets.name: Test: real apps

presets.description: An animated aurora across all 15 keys, fire on the dial, LED effects.
presets.name: Test: aurora

presets.description: One picture across all 15 keys; the keys still act.
presets.name: Test: full panel

presets.description: Skills 1-4, potion, evade, mount, portal, map, inventory and panels; game, Discord and music volumes.
presets.name: Diablo IV

presets.description: End turn, turn-based mode, shove, throw, jump, sneak, the panels, quicksave and quickload.
presets.name: Baldur's Gate 3

presets.description: Weapon slots, reload, inspect, drop, use, buy menu, scores, radio and chats.
presets.name: Counter-Strike 2

presets.description: Abilities and ultimate, weapon slots, spike, reload, use, ping, map and scores.
presets.name: Valorant

presets.description: Building pieces (F1-F5), edit, item slots 1-5, map, inventory, emote and repair.
presets.name: Fortnite

presets.description: Hotbar slots, inventory, drop, swap hands, chat, players, advancements, camera, screenshot, debug.
presets.name: Minecraft

presets.description: Q W E R, summoner spells, items and trinket, recall, shop, scores, camera lock and center.
presets.name: League of Legends
